name: 家用双层压纹厨房纸巾提装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用前后错位的两包提装坐实家庭量贩的第一印象。
开篇第二镜锁定预期，用同框双卡说明外装焕新而内物不变，降低到货落差退货。
shots.textZone: 顶部 24% 纯色留白带供一行主张「{selling_point_1}」，两卡下方各一枚空白标签位

shots.intent: 一秒把四条核心卖点压成可扫读的图标矩阵，承上启下进入证据段。
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 留白带供「{selling_point_2}」，四格下方各一行空白标签位供「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 把单张摊开在食物级木台上，用折痕与压纹点证明纸面结构而非口头宣称。
shots.textZone: 左上圆角留白卡位供「{callout_5}」，其余区域不放字

shots.intent: 微距锁住干纸、湿纸与压纹交界的一线，让吸收这件事被看见而不是被说出。
把纸放回清晨咖啡泼洒的真实台面，让买家代入自己家的那一张桌子。
用两行线性卷筒示意图把幅面差异画成可比的结构问题，替买家消除规格疑虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部 26% 留白带供「{selling_point_4}」，两行左侧各一行空白标签位供「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」

shots.intent: 以航拍针叶林与一枚空白印章框收口，把原料出身讲成可信但不可造假的视觉证据。
shots.textZone: 中央圆角空白印章框，内部不出现任何字样、注册号或角标图形

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF cyclorama for packshots, full-bleed signal orange #EE6C1A and pale peach #FBE7DC flat fields for the infographic screens, warm oak butcher-block #D8B285 for counter screens, deep forest green #1F4A3A aerial field for the trust close
style.direction: value household-paper commerce with flat infographic panels
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line outline glyphs in #EE6C1A, uniform 6pt stroke, flat 2D, no fill, no gradient, no shading
style.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light with a broad front-left key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows, no hard speculars; counter screens lit by soft daylight from the left at 5200K, canopy screen under even overcast top light at 6000K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent value household-paper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of signal orange #EE6C1A, pale peach #FBE7DC, clean white #FFFFFF and deep forest green #1F4A3A with a warm oak surface #D8B285; warm high-key studio lighting with broad front-left key, bounce fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one heavy display headline band; single-family thin-line outline icon set in #EE6C1A only; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic panels and blank label plates; stable slight 3/4 pack angle and consistent product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented numerals, units, ratio marks or badge artwork
style.presentationRules: packs upright with the roll tops reading as one level row; a torn sheet always spread flat with the fold crease visible; both panels of any split screen share identical angle, crop, scale and light
style.surfaceSystem: warm oak butcher-block counter #D8B285 with visible grain for touch screens, matte pale board #EFE3D6 for macro screens, flat colour fields elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy display headline band plus one light sub-line, copy only inside reserved blank bands and rounded white plates
